fields.label: SSN
fields.description: Social Security Number used as the taxpayer identification number for individuals, including individuals conducting business under their own name

fields.label: ITIN
fields.description: Individual Taxpayer Identification Number issued by the U.S. Internal Revenue Service to individuals who require a U.S. taxpayer identification number for tax purposes but are not eligible for a Social Security Number

fields.label: EIN
fields.description: Employer Identification Number issued by the U.S. Internal Revenue Service and used by businesses and other entities for federal and Puerto Rico tax purposes

fields.label: Merchant Registration Number
fields.description: Merchant Registration Number assigned by the Puerto Rico Department of the Treasury through the Merchant Registry for Sales and Use Tax (IVU) purposes
